== Wintertodt Prep ==

{{Checklist|title=Section 5|

** 1 Banana
** 3 Pots of Flour

* Buy from the [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Sarah%27s_Farming_shop. Falador Farm Shop]
** 9 Sacks
** 1 Secateurs
** 1 Seed Dibber
** 1 Rake
** 1 Trowel
** 3 Plant Pots
** 5 Watering Cans
** 2 Plant Cures
** 1 Bucket

* Start [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/The_Knight%27s_Sword The Knight's Sword] until you're done speaking with the Squire
* Progress [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Black_Knights%27_Fortress Black Knight's Fortress] until you've spoken with [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Sir_Amik_Varze Sir Amik Varze] (first step)

* Progress [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/The_Knight%27s_Sword The Knight's Sword] until you've spoken to [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Reldo Reldo]

{{Checklist|title=Section 7|
* [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Chronicle Chronicle] tele, Bank
* withdraw GP, Knife, Boots of Lightness, Forestry Kit, Feathers, arrow shafts
* Do the [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Natural_history_quiz Natural History Quiz] downstairs in the [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Varrock_Museum Varrock Museum]
* Take Quetzal and run to [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Quetzacalli_Gorge Quetzacalli Gorge], buy 3 [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Quetzacalli_Gorge_General_Store Charcoal]
* Take the [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Mountain_Guide Mountain Guide] to [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Auburnvale Auburnvale]
* Buy an [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Lunami%27s_Axe_Shop Adamant Axe]
* Get 15 fletching by using feathers on arrowshafts (keep 1 feather minimum)
* Get 20 Fletching with Oaks to the north
* Bank, withdraw GP, Knife, Boots of Lightness, Forestry Kit, Adamant Axe
* Complete [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Vale_Totems_(miniquest) Vale Totems] (miniquest)
* Repeat [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Vale_Totems Vale Totems] until [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Fletching_knife Fletching Knife]
** Spend afk time cutting logs and active time doing [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Vale_Totems Vale Totems]
** You can sell [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Bow_string_spool Bow String Spool's] for points
** Use the highest type logs you can depending on your Fletching level
* Minigame Tele to Soul Wars. Bank all, withdraw Adamant Axe, Tinderbox, Forestry Kit
* Woodcut to 50 Firemaking on Teaks on the Forestry world
* Passive - Get 73 Woodcutting
** We won't need this until after 92 Firemaking, no need to rush!
** Teaks at Soul Wars are fairly chill
** After [[Bone Voyage]] Consider [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Sulliuscep/Strategies Sulliusceps] until you get 5 Sulliuscep Caps or like the method
** Afk method is just chopping Yews until 70. Less XP but extremely afk
* Minigame tele to Fishing Trawler, Bank
* withdraw Leather Gloves, Spade, Hammer, Saw, 1 Beer, House Tele, 1 Feather, gp
* Complete [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Tower_of_Life Tower of Life]
* Break POH Tab, travel with [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Veos Veos] at Port Sarim Northern Dock to go to Kourend
* Progress [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Client_of_Kourend Client of Kourend] until you're in Shayzien
** While visiting Jennifer, buy Shears from her shop
** Visit Robyn west of her store, buy Chef's Hat, grab Orange Dye, and Black Wizard Hat (spawn in building)
** Dig up the [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Clue_hunter_garb Clue Hunter Garb]
* Progress [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Client_of_Kourend Client of Kourend] until you've activated the orb near the Dark Altar
* Travel to [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Wintertodt Wintertodt]
* Bank, withdraw Fletching Knife, Tinderbox, Hammer, Adamant Axe, Rainbow Scarf, 3x Clue Hunter pieces, 4 Cakes
* Do [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Wintertodt Wintertodt] until 60 Woodcutting and 92 Firemaking (Optionally 98/99)
* Don't open any loot until 60 Woodcutting at minimum. Make sure you have 16 Magic Logs before leaving
